title: Delete reflection-based RepositoryBase and inline its methods in CarnivalBlocksRepository + MeetingsRepository
objective: Remove lib/data/repositories/base/repository_base.dart and the now-unused lib/core/irepository_base.dart, then refactor CarnivalBlocksRepository and MeetingsRepository to call their typed API clients directly — eliminating the generic-JSON-factory indirection that obscures the actual HTTP route of every call.
description: RepositoryBase<TEntity> (lib/data/repositories/base/repository_base.dart, 36 lines) plus IRepositoryBase<TEntity> (lib/core/irepository_base.dart, 9 lines) form a generic CRUD superclass that every repository extends. The indirection forces every call to pass a JsonFactory<TEntity>, which loses the per-endpoint response shape (e.g. CarnivalBlocksEntity vs MeetingsEntity have different fields, but RepositoryBase treats them identically through a Map<String, dynamic>). The fix deletes both files, removes `extends RepositoryBase<TEntity>` from CarnivalBlocksRepository and MeetingsRepository, removes `implements IRepositoryBase<TEntity>` from their interfaces, and inlines the four methods (getAllAsync, getByIdAsync, deleteByIdAsync, createAsync) so each one calls its concrete API client directly. The interfaces become redundant — if a repository no longer shares any supertype with another repository, its I… interface file is also deletable; this subtask deletes IRepositoryBase and keeps the per-domain I… files only if they declare domain-specific methods beyond the CRUD four. The lib/core/ dependency on irepository_base.dart must be removed; if any other file imports it (a quick `rg -n irepository_base.dart lib/` confirms), update those imports too.

reference_files.reason: Rewrite — drop `implements IRepositoryBase<CarnivalBlocksEntity>`. Keep the existing getByIdAsync, getAllAsync, deleteAsync signatures, ADD a domain-specific updateAsync (already used by CarnivalBlocksApiClient.updateAsync), and drop createAsync if no caller needs it (search `rg -n '_carnivalBlocksRepository\.createAsync' lib/` first).
Rewrite — drop `extends RepositoryBase<CarnivalBlocksEntity>`. Implement every method declared on the interface by delegating to CarnivalBlocksApiClient. Keep the constructor.

fix_shape.icarnival_blocks_repository_after: abstract interface class ICarnivalBlocksRepository { AsyncResult<CarnivalBlocksEntity> getByIdAsync(int id); AsyncResult<List<CarnivalBlocksEntity>> getAllAsync(); AsyncResult<CarnivalBlocksEntity> updateAsync(int id, Map<String, dynamic> data); AsyncResult deleteAsync(int id); AsyncResult<CarnivalBlocksEntity> getByInviteCodeAsync(String inviteCode); /* from H2a */ }
fix_shape.carnival_blocks_repository_after: class CarnivalBlocksRepository implements ICarnivalBlocksRepository { CarnivalBlocksRepository({required ICarnivalBlocksApiClient carnivalBlocksApiClient}) : _api = carnivalBlocksApiClient; final ICarnivalBlocksApiClient _api; @override AsyncResult<CarnivalBlocksEntity> getByIdAsync(int id) => _api.getByIdAsync(id); /* ... etc, one delegation per interface method ... */ }
fix_shape.imeetings_repository_after: Same shape — list every method on MeetingsApiClient that the project actually uses (check via `rg -n '_meetingsRepository\.' lib/`).
fix_shape.unused_interface_check: Run `rg -n irepository_base.dart lib/` and `rg -n repository_base.dart lib/`. Any remaining import is a candidate bug — fix the import to point at the concrete interface (e.g. ICarnivalBlocksRepository) or, if the file truly used only the generic CRUD four, rewrite the file's logic to call the API client directly.

acceptance_criteria: lib/core/irepository_base.dart is deleted (file no longer exists)
CarnivalBlocksRepository no longer extends any superclass — it implements ICarnivalBlocksRepository directly with explicit delegation to ICarnivalBlocksApiClient
MeetingsRepository no longer extends any superclass — same treatment

Every method previously inherited from RepositoryBase (getAllAsync, getByIdAsync, deleteByIdAsync, createAsync) is now implemented inline in the concrete repository, calling its typed API client directly
No call site that previously called `carnivalBlocksRepo.getByIdAsync(int)` etc. needs to change — public method signatures are preserved
No `rg -n irepository_base.dart lib/` or `rg -n repository_base.dart lib/` returns any matches
flutter analyze lib/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n 'RepositoryBase' lib/ must return zero matches
rg -n 'IRepositoryBase' lib/ must return zero matches
rg -n 'repository_base\.dart|irepository_base\.dart' lib/ must return zero matches
validation.call_site_audit: Run `rg -n '_carnivalBlocksRepository\.|_meetingsRepository\.' lib/ui lib/config` and verify every call site still compiles against the new interface shape.

no_op_outside_scope: Do not touch ICarnivalBlockMembersRepository / IMeetingPresencesRepository / IMembersRepository unless they also extend RepositoryBase / implement IRepositoryBase — in that case the same deletion applies, but only to the files that currently do. Verify with `rg -n 'RepositoryBase|IRepositoryBase' lib/data/repositories/` first.
follow_up: H4 (MeetingPresencesRepository.getAllAsync 404 handling) runs AFTER this subtask — H3 deletes the IRepositoryBase superclass that H4's current stub relies on.
